headline: Older Adults Projected to Drive Nearly 40% of Colombian Consumption by 2042
summary: A study by CESA indicates that adults over 55 will drive nearly four out of every ten pesos of consumption in Colombia by 2042, with their economic impact rising to 18.7% of GDP.
why: Demographic shifts toward an aging population alter long-term sector allocations, driving growth in healthcare, financial services, and consumer staples.
